title: In resolveToHeavyWeightSwitcherIfNeeded of ActivityStarter.java, there is a possible background… (CVE-2026-58957)
description: CVE-2026-58957 is a vulnerability in the resolveToHeavyWeightSwitcherIfNeeded function of ActivityStarter.java that allows a possible background activity launch due to a confused deputy issue. This flaw enables local escalation of privilege without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 8.4 and impacts confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
